description: Manuscript set A with a primed burst above replacement (b_R = 2 > 1), sweeping D_s across the outrun threshold (Table 7: D_s,crit ~ 6.45 with the maturation race; § 3.10). Uses the manuscript density cutoff (no infection below V_ext = p_ext, removal at rate 5); without it, stalls restart by non-physical tail tunnelling.

expected.D_s below ~6.5: wave_fast: steady front at c0 ~ 2.12 with no halo
expected.D_s above ~6.5: wave_halo (steady slow wave ~ kappa C(b_R) ~ 1.2 carrying a primed halo); without a density cutoff the PDE may instead show tunnelling leaps and halo oscillations, classified unsteady
